title.narrative: Heritage and Identity for Al-Ahmadi's sustainable development

description.narrative: This project represents Phase 1 of a heritage-based development plan for Al-Ahmadi, Kuwait, integrating heritage conservation with urban regeneration and community engagement. Using the approach of the UNESCO Recommendation on Historic Urban Landscape, it aims to assess and document Al-Ahmadi’s modern heritage—including its souq, cinema, and residential areas—and create a heritage-based development vision while fostering cultural tourism, creative industries, youth and sports strategies. Channeled by UNDP Kuwait, the initiative aligns with Kuwait Vision 2035 and seeks to create a strategic vision for Phase 2, while strengthening institutional capacities and aiming to position Al-Ahmadi as a model for culture-driven urban revitalization.
